semantics.mutation_rule: read-only content generation; performs no filesystem write or output commit
semantics.alias_rule: shared canonical tensor storages are emitted once and tensor views retain offsets/strides
semantics.shape_rule: nested values are bounded to depth 64 and one million nodes
semantics.layout_rule: deterministic stored ZIP with protocol-2 pickle metadata
semantics.numeric_rule: PyTorch-compatible archive content; final publication remains owned by OutputCommitter
semantics.determinism: BTreeMap ordering, stable storage discovery, zero timestamps
semantics.cancellation_points: before and during value encoding and ZIP construction
